name: runtime-profile-applicability
goal: Require real profiles for executable units without asking declarative CSS for a nonexistent module call; unreadable and mixed sources remain required.

steps.title: Identify the regression, prior working behavior, root cause, and evidence.
steps.evidence: The completed whole-history audit asks 32 CSS-only units for module latency and memory. The executable classifier treats every readable file without exports as executable, including CSS. This originated in the earlier mandatory profiling implementation; type-only exclusions do not address styles.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the regression; name the coverage gap and reusable test or shared guard change.
steps.evidence: The standardized performance-evidence suite covers type-only exports, unreadable files and unexported scripts, but not declarative stylesheet-only or mixed CSS/code units. Add that applicability matrix while preserving unknown and executable-source requirements.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Sealed red 078014d6aa1800e80b7f153cc0905648e03087193f5a199e75fcec59666e6bd6 at 25e06b3c fails because readable CSS is incorrectly required. The same matrix also asserts unreadable CSS and mixed executable ownership remain required.

steps.title: Propose a root-cause repair and an automated guard for the identified failure.
steps.evidence: Inspect source languages after the unreadable guard, excluding only readable CSS from module executability. Preserve empty ownership, unknown files, unexported scripts and mixed-unit requirements. Add the applicability matrix checkpoint to the existing local Harness skill.

steps.title: Implement the repair and wire the prevention test or guard into normal project verification.
steps.evidence: Readable CSS-only module source is exempt from nonexistent callable profiling; unreadable CSS, mixed code, unexported scripts and unknown ownership remain required. All18 focused tests, types and source audit pass. The local Harness skill requires the full applicability matrix before classifier changes and validates successfully.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Sealed same-process red217b65c561f6371cb50cb55d76158e915332fe239908868c21c99fa9d37a77b9 at25e06b3c and green1c5c868cdfdfda79de6e4936f01d9160496b8ab6640136961e7ca020acdcca60 at90bf151f use identical frozen tests and command. All11 validator cases pass, with actual 1,000-unit validation latency and process RSS observations.

steps.title: In an isolated fixture or temporary workspace, prove reintroducing the original failure makes the guard fail; restore and prove it passes.
steps.evidence: The isolated red snapshot restores the old classifier and fails the CSS-only assertion. The isolated green snapshot passes the unchanged declarative, executable, unknown, unreadable and mixed-source matrix. Existing task completion tests retain mandatory executable profiles without budgets.

steps.title: Repeat until the guard and relevant project checks pass; verify affected UI flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending while proof fails.
